changes: Compare each of ten retained Mech JIT Benchmarks Game workloads with its fastest eligible recorded external JIT peer, independently of AOT Rust.
Admit older unknown-mode Julia and Java profiles only from source-bound JIT-enabled launcher recipes; retain original mode fields and the launcher evidence in the projection.
Exclude JIT-disabled launchers, AOT and interpreted modes, invalid samples, ineligible profiles and timing aliases from JIT reference selection.
Keep newer JIT observations without equivalent JIT peers timing-only; every JIT backend rejects automatic AOT Rust fallback.
Apply one color scale to chart points, table ratios, outcomes and hover readouts: green wins, yellow-to-amber losses through 10x, graded reds above 10x, neutral exact ties.
Use reciprocal cost for throughput loss severity, and retain enough ratio digits to distinguish exact ties and the 10x color threshold.
Keep all retained AOT comparisons, native DEFLATE observations, source bytes and timing samples unchanged.

jit_reference_admission.selection: Fastest qualified recorded external JIT program per workload, across program inventory and chart programs.
jit_reference_admission.timing: Retained complete-process observations, including startup, JIT compilation, input/output and shutdown.
jit_reference_admission.mode_evidence: Explicit JIT mode or source-bound recorded runtime launcher with JIT enabled; this is not a machine-code trace of every executed operation.
